text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I visited the cafeteria for lunch, I 
spotted Shinko Windy. For some reason, she 
kept glancing over at Biwa Hayahide...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh, they're back...! They haven't 
noticed a thing...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? The position of the cup seems 
slightly different from earlier... No, is 
it just my imagination?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Hm?! This is...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gyahaha! You drank it, you drank it! How 
is it? Tastes gross, right?!
choice_data_list: Wh-what... Windy, what did you pull?!
Wh-what... Windy, what did you do?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I swapped the cup's contents with my 
special ultra-nasty drink! How do you like 
that, Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Windy-kun's handiwork, I take it? It 
caught me off guard since it didn't taste 
like coffee.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nishishi! Hayahide, does it taste so bad 
you're gonna cry?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mm... The ingredients seem to be coffee 
and an assortment of vegetables, I gather. 
The taste is certainly dreadful, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Vitamins, minerals, amino acids... And on 
top of that, alpha-lipoic acid, and so 
on...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This seems like a pretty great drink, 
promising plenty of essential nutrients!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Feh? W-What are you saying...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If we improve the flavor, everyone else 
will appreciate it too. If you'd like, I 
could provide reference data on the 
ingredient ratios.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What...?! Windy-chan doesn't want 
anyone to be happy for her!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It pisses me off! Hayahide, next time I'm 
gonna shut you up for good--!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
—That does it! The hole is completely 
covered! ...Hm?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, a pitfall trap this time? However, 
you really should match the color of the 
grass covering the hole. It's far too easy 
to spot like this.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hoh, a toy snake. How realistic. From a 
distance, it looks like a real one.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, if placed in the grass, it would 
appear even more realistic and surprise 
them further, would it not? What do you 
think, Windy-kun?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah?! Why do I have to take advice from 
Hayahide?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Shinko Windy kept trying to 
prank Biwa Hayahide after that. However, 
it seems every single attempt ended in 
failure.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm. I only wished to cooperate so that the 
prank on me would succeed, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't an honest opinion be helpful for 
improving your pranks?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I don't need any help! I wanna surprise 
Hayahide all on my own~!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!? Why are you laughing?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, forgive me. It just brought back old 
memories. Though my sister was never quite 
this mischievous when she was little.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugahh!!? Don't compare me to my sister!? 
Windy-chan is Windy-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy got stubborn and looks ready 
to lunge at Biwa Hayahide at any moment. I 
need to say something to calm her down.
choice_data_list:
Let's use Biwa Hayahide's advice as a 
reference.
Let's surprise them on our own power!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mgggh...! Then, would that be enough to 
surprise Hayahide...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Guuuugh, I'm gonna do thissss!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mmh. There's something in the grass... —Is 
this a toy snake...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh, so you listened to my advice. Though 
finding it before you did was rather bad 
of me――

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wahahahaha! You let your guard down!! I'm 
not gonna do what you advised me to 
do-nodan!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I-I see... So the toy was just a bluff...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You got me, Windy-kun. That was a 
splendid prank.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wahahahaha! That's right, that's right! 
Hayahide, how do you like that!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy didn't just take the 
advice—she put her own spin on it and 
managed to completely catch Biwa Hayahide 
off guard!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Of course I am! I'm gonna come up with 
lots and lots more pranks!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I see. I guess my advice was just 
meddling, then.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to seeing what kind of 
prank awaits next, Windy-kun.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugahh!? Don't look forward to it~!! You're 
supposed to be terrified~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oops, my bad. Guess I'll spend my days 
dreading your next prank.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grrr...! Curse you, Hayahide~! I will, 
ab-so-lutely, terrify the heck outta 
you~!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Just you wait! I'll come up with 
something incredible! I'll definitely make 
you scream, Hayahide!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy immediately started plotting 
her next prank. She looked somewhat 
delighted as she did so.
